create.name: Mary Rose Freeth
create.bio:
Mary Rose Freeth is a meditation guide who lives on Grand Manan, an island in the Bay of Fundy off New Brunswick, Canada. She spent her working life as a registered nurse, and it was a period of exhaustion and strain in that life that first drew her to sit quietly each day. What began as a personal practice grew into MeTime Meditations, the online home she set up to share heart-centred guided meditation with anyone who wants a gentler pace.

Her recordings are calm and unhurried, usually ten to twenty minutes long, and draw on loving kindness, compassion practice, ho'oponopono, body scans, yoga nidra and visualisations set in nature, with binaural beats in some tracks. Recurring themes are self-kindness, opening the heart, creativity, abundance and kinder relationships with others. Since 2020 she has run a members' circle with a library of more than two hundred meditations, alongside a lighter monthly plan that sends a new thirty-day journey each month and a free seven-day series for newcomers. She also shares many of her meditations freely on YouTube and on Insight Timer, where listeners around the world follow her work.

courses.title: The Inner Circle [Premium Membership]
courses.description: Her full membership, running since 2020: open access to a library of more than 230 guided meditations and over a dozen thirty-day journeys, plus each new monthly journey with a daily email. Suitable for beginners and seasoned meditators alike.

courses.title: Monthly Meditation Journeys
courses.description: The lighter plan: a fresh thirty-day series arrives every month around a single theme, with one guided practice and a short email each day. You can cancel at any point.

courses.title: Compassionate Relationships - lifetime access
courses.description: A set of eight recorded meditations that start with how you treat yourself and then turn towards others, covering self-love, boundaries, forgiveness and goodwill. Bought once and kept for life.

free_resources.title: Mary Rose Freeth on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Gentle heart-centred guided meditations on self-kindness, letting go and abundance, recorded in her calm voice. The single tracks are free to hear.

free_resources.title: Free 7-Day Heart-Centered Guided Meditations
free_resources.description: A free week-long introduction to her style: seven guided meditations about caring for and going easy on yourself, delivered to a member area after a free sign-up.

flags: Her footer links a 'Presence Studio on Grand Manan Island, NB' Facebook page, but no public page confirming in-person classes could be read; availability set to worldwide, city/country left null. Worth a human check, as local_online would suit Near You.
Insight Timer bio could only be partly quoted by WebFetch; bio check relied mainly on her own site pages.
Video picks are from her 30 most recent uploads (view counts read there); older videos were not ranked.
Several of her own titles say 'healing' (Love and Compassion: A Healing Meditation; Ho'oponopono Healing Meditation); kept as emotional/spiritual wording with no condition named.
left_out: Sleep Meditations package: includes a 'Sleep Meditation for Immune Support' track (health claim).
Videos titled for stress or overthinking (Mindfulness for Stress and Overthinking, Golden Glow: Let Go of Stress) left out.
Weekly Newsletter page: a sign-up, not a resource.
No books found; no Insight Timer courses listed on her profile.
